baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural mountains stands between a motion verb and its cognate accusative, tasiru ... sayran.
baseline_models.mechanism: A high solid mass, normally used as a fixed landmark, is assigned sustained going or running; the repeated motion root makes mobility the event's dominant fact rather than an incidental tremor.

activation_trace.role: Going and running supply literal locomotion, while the doubled focus occurrence makes that locomotion sustained and emphatic.
The high solid mass supplies the expectation of fixedness that the motion construction overturns.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are scenery within which an event occurs.
changed_reading.after: The supposedly fixed landmarks themselves become the sustained moving event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tasiru can activate removal or driving away, while the mountain branch marks material hardness that stops penetration.
baseline_models.mechanism: Motion is not limited to travel along an intact surface: the resistant obstruction is removed from the place where its hardness formerly arrested movement.

activation_trace.role: Removal and expulsion turn movement into displacement from an established site.
Hard ground that stops digging supplies deep anchorage and resistance, making its removal more radical than surface travel.

changed_reading.before: Mountains move while remaining mountains seated in their terrain.
changed_reading.after: The terrain's hardest arresting masses are cleared or driven out of their seats.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots can denote a thing's way or state and its inborn formed constitution.
baseline_models.mechanism: The movement can occur at the level of condition: what was formed with mountain-nature passes into another mode, so fixedness is no longer constitutive.

activation_trace.role: Way, conduct, or state shifts motion from mere location to the condition a thing is upon.
Innate formed nature supplies the constitution whose apparent fixedness is being altered.

changed_reading.after: Mountainhood's own settled mode changes; mobility reaches constitution as well as place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural mountains can activate a mountain-like multitude, while movement can activate a traveling company.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural masses cohere as a moving collective, preserving the possibility of procession or convoy alongside violent geological displacement.

activation_trace.role: A company on the road supplies collective, ordered travel rather than isolated object motion.
Mountain-like abundance supplies the enormous multitude that can move as one company.

changed_reading.after: An immense plurality advances as a massed traveling company.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky oscillates and pours in recurrent motion immediately before the solid mountains run; the two adjacent cognate constructions form a coupled loss of both overhead and terrestrial reference frames.

activation_trace.role: Going and running provide the terrestrial half of the coupled kinetic sequence.
High solid masses provide the lower frame whose fixedness fails.
Oscillation and wave-like recurrence supply instability in the immediately preceding motion.
Rapid travel with oscillation links the sky's motion dynamically to the focus root's running.
The covering sky supplies the upper frame that moves before the mountains.

structural_cues: 52:9 and 52:10 are adjacent, and each pairs a motion verb with a cognate accusative; their subjects descend from sky to mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent repeated-motion constructions, sky oscillation, running, and solid mass; I infer mechanical coupling between upper and lower frames. A live alternative is a serial list of independent portents with no causal coupling.

changed_reading.before: Only the mountains undergo an extraordinary journey.
changed_reading.after: Mountain motion is the lower phase of a coordinated world-frame convulsion already underway in the sky.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence activates limits, successive phases, a high roof, a sea able to switch between filling and ignition, an event that falls and fixes, and the failure of repulsion. Mountain movement becomes a threshold where the bounded architecture of the world changes operating state.

activation_trace.role: A change of way or state lets the movement register as phase transition as well as travel.
The high solid landmark is the world-layer whose stable function changes.
A stopping or transgressed limit supplies the threshold crossed by the focus event.
Successive phases supply a state-sequence rather than a single displacement.
The high roof supplies another normally fixed world-boundary in the layered architecture.
Filling with water supplies one charged state of the sea boundary.
Ignition supplies a coexisting state reversal, making phase change materially vivid.
Falling and becoming fixed give the threatened event irreversible arrival.
Repelling or removing harm supplies the blocked counterforce: this transition cannot be pushed away.

structural_cues: 52:1-10 proceeds through mountain, inscribed surface, inhabited house, raised roof, charged sea, inevitable event, failed defense, moving sky, and moving mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a limit, phase succession, layered boundaries, incompatible sea states, fixed arrival, and failed repulsion; I infer one ordered system crossing a threshold. A live alternative is that these are independent oath-images and consequences rather than parts of one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mountains change location inside an otherwise stable cosmos.
changed_reading.after: Their motion marks the threshold at which the cosmos's limits, layers, and material states stop functioning as background and enter transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later verb-plus-cognate construction of being shoved toward fire echoes the focus construction. Together with the focus branches of expulsion and forcing, it activates mountain motion as compulsory removal under an unstated force, not self-directed travel.

activation_trace.role: Removal and driving away supply displacement under pressure rather than voluntary travel.
Forcing onto a matter supplies a coercive branch internal to the focus noun.
A severe shove supplies the directional force mirrored by the later cognate construction.
Kindled fire supplies an assigned destination, sharpening motion into compelled transfer.

structural_cues: 52:10 has tasiru ... sayran; 52:13 answers with yuda''una ... da''an and an explicit destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two nearby intensified motion constructions, expulsion, forcing, a severe shove, and fire; I infer that the second construction discloses the coercive dynamics latent in the first. A live alternative is that the grammatical echo intensifies two unrelated motions without transferring agency.

changed_reading.before: The mountains mysteriously move of themselves.
changed_reading.after: They are effectively cleared and driven along an imposed course, even though the focus leaves the mover unspoken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rows, following, catching up and joining, circling, and groups facing one another provide a grammar of coordinated motion. They strengthen the focus-only caravan reading: plural mountains may move in maintained relation, not merely scatter chaotically.

activation_trace.role: A traveling company supplies the collective vehicle for ordered mountain motion.
Mountain-like multitude lets the geological plural behave as one immense company.
Alignment on a level line supplies formation and spacing within the moving collective.
Following behind supplies directional succession.
A later member catching and reaching what is ahead supplies cohesion across the procession.
Circling supplies a curved or orbital path rather than only straight translation.
A group turning toward one another supplies maintained mutual orientation.

structural_cues: 52:20-25 repeatedly choreographs bodies as rows, followers joined to those ahead, circling attendants, and mutually facing groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relational motion and arrangement in the later social scene; I project that choreography back onto the focus plural to strengthen its caravan branches. A live alternative is that paradise's social order has no bearing on the earlier catastrophic kinetics.

changed_reading.before: Mountain motion is necessarily random collapse or dispersal.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading sees the mountain multitude proceeding in formation, with succession, spacing, curvature, and mutual orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation questions activate formed constitution and the earth's downward, clinging inertia; the nearby branch of changing one form into another makes mountain motion a rewriting of created disposition rather than translation alone.

activation_trace.role: Way or state provides the focus anchor for a changed mode of being.
Innate formed nature supplies the disposition being rewritten.
Completed, proportioned formation supplies authored physical constitution for heavens and earth.
Changing an image or substituting one thing for another activates transformation beyond displacement.
Clinging and growing heavy toward the ground supplies the inertia that mountain motion reverses.

structural_cues: 52:35-36 repeats creation questions and expands from human origin to the heavens and the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authored formation, a change-of-form branch, earthbound heaviness, and the focus's formed-nature branch; I infer that the author of constitution can reverse its settled disposition. A live alternative is that the creation questions establish authority without specifying any transformation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Created mountains retain their nature while being transported.
changed_reading.after: The event rewrites the earthbound disposition built into them, so mobile mountainhood is itself a newly operative created state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later visible object is a detached sky-piece falling, being named a cloud, and appearing dragged and piled. That sequence revises mountain removal into possible fragmentation and cloudlike transport: solid masses need not travel intact or remain recognizable.

activation_trace.role: Removal supplies departure from the mountain's seat and permits loss of intact placement.
High solid mass supplies the material whose altered appearance requires explanation.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies fragmentation into separately moving masses.
Downward fall adds a trajectory absent from the focus's unmarked travel.
The non-dominant split branch of shaking and movement makes the observers' naming occur inside, rather than outside, the kinetic scene.
Dragging and extending supply cloudlike horizontal transport of detached material.
Accumulation layer over layer supplies the piled appearance that can obscure the material's origin.

structural_cues: 52:44 presents one continuous perceptual sequence: seeing, detached piece, sky, falling, saying, cloud, piled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies detached material, falling, a motion-bearing non-dominant mapping, dragging, piling, and misclassification as cloud; I infer that moving mountain matter could fragment and become visually cloudlike. A live alternative is that 52:44 concerns an entirely separate sky object and only illustrates persistent denial.

changed_reading.before: Whole mountains translate as recognizable units.
changed_reading.after: They may be removed in detached masses whose fall, drag, and piling make moving geology look like cloud.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses geology, textile, and writing domains; it remains anchored in the focus branches of strap-like lines and firm weaving and is activated by the opening written, lined, thin, spread substrate. Downstream prose should present it as a material-visual analogy, not as a replacement translation of mountains.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots independently permit striped bands and firm woven structure, while the opening supplies an inscribed sheet being opened out.

activation_trace.role: Stripes resembling straps turn movement into the shifting of long visible bands.
Firmly made weaving supplies a structured substrate for the mountain bands.
Ordered letters and the written object supply inscription as a material arrangement.
A written row supplies parallel linear organization matching the focus's striped bands.
The written sheet supplies the thin surface across which the visual bands can shift.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the substrate's dynamic unfolding.

changed_reading.before: Mountains travel across a geographic surface.
changed_reading.after: Firm ridges can appear as inscribed or woven bands shifting across a world-surface being unrolled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets social branch-images coexist with the literal geology; it remains anchored in focus branches for mountain-like multitudes, chiefs like mountains, and expulsion, then gains context from following kin and household belonging. Downstream prose should call it a social echo or analogy, not claim that the lexical subject ceases to be geological mountains.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun can image great communities or chiefs as mountains, and its motion root can denote being driven from one's place.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion supplies forced migration from an established place.
A mountain-like multitude supplies communities large enough to function as social terrain.
Chiefs likened to mountains supply social pillars whose removal would reorder a people.
Loyal succession supplies kin moving in relation to those who lead.
Those behind catching those ahead supplies social reassembly after movement.
Nearness and belonging in a household supply the social unit affected by removal or reunion.

changed_reading.after: The geological event can carry a contained echo of communities and their mountain-like leaders being displaced, followed, and rejoined.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context occurrences conventionally concern praise, yet their retained motion branch is running or swimming and the closing stars have their own recession. It remains anchored in literal focus travel by solid masses. Downstream prose should render buoyancy or orbit as a kinetic analogy, not assert that the mountains literally become swimmers or stars.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Literal mountain travel is repeatedly activated by a context root whose branch joins running with swimming, ending beside the stars' recession.

activation_trace.role: Going and running anchor actual traverse by the mountain masses.
High solid mass preserves the outlier's paradoxical weight.
Running and swimming introduce unsupported or fluid-like traverse into the surah's motion field.
The repeated running-swimming branch keeps that motion active at the closing celestial horizon.
The passing end or receding aftermath supplies temporal departure rather than a static endpoint.
The rising star supplies the celestial moving field against which mountain traverse can be analogically suspended.

changed_reading.before: Mountains slide only along the ground plane.
changed_reading.after: A contained kinetic analogy lets the heavy masses traverse a fluid or celestial field, coordinated with recession and emergence.

strongest_changes: The exact adjacent cognate-motion pattern in 52:9-10 couples sky oscillation to mountain locomotion.
The shove-plus-cognate pattern in 52:13 revises travel toward compelled displacement.
The relational choreography of 52:20-25 preserves ordered procession beside catastrophic motion.
The detached, falling, dragged, and piled sequence in 52:44 keeps fragmentation and cloudlike transport live.
summary.what_was_special: The focus branches already support four incompatible but anchored mechanics: literal running, removal from a resistant seat, change of formed state, and caravan-like collective motion. Context sharpened each differently instead of forcing a single synthesis, and a non-dominant split mapping in 52:44 added motion inside the act of misnaming what is seen.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the inscription-and-weave reading is more than a deliberately contained material analogy.
Whether the 52:44 cloudlike mass shares material identity with the moving mountains or only parallels their perceptual shock.
Whether the social chiefs-and-communities activation should remain an echo rather than enter ordinary commentary.
Whether the coercive agent is intentionally latent in 52:10 or supplied only by the later grammatical echo.
